text: Esonica Veira, born on June 8, 1990, is a US Virgin Islander model and beauty queen who won the title of Miss Universe US Virgin Islands 2017 and represented the US Virgin Islands at the Miss Universe 2017 pageant on November 26, 2017 in Las Vegas, Nevada. She was the territory's representative for Miss Earth 2014 and previously competed in the Miss World 2011 pageant held in London, UK. After her Miss World participation, she was selected to compete in Miss Supranational 2013 in Minsk, Belarus. In May 2013, she was crowned Miss US Paradise Supranational and represented the US Virgin Islands at the Miss Supranational Pageant, where she placed as second runner-up in the Talent Finals and fourth runner-up in the Grand Finale, becoming the first US Virgin Islands representative to place in the Top 5 of an international pageant. The pageant was won by Mutya Johanna Datul of the Philippines. In November 2014, she flew to the Philippines to compete for the Miss Earth title, which was held to succeed Alyz Henrich, but did not place; however, she was awarded Best Teacher and Best in Talent. Esonica has been a top model in St. Thomas since the age of 9, beginning with the Roses and Champagne Agency, and has participated in various fashion events, including the Face of Shabeau in Barbados, where she won the cover model spot, and the Caribbean Fashion Week Catwalk in the Virgin Islands. Her big break came in 2007 when she joined America's Next Top Model, making the first cut during casting call auditions in Montgomery, Alabama. She was also a finalist in the singing competition V.I. Idol in 2008. Her achievements include winning Ms. Hal Jackson's Virgin Islands Talented Teen 2005, Ms. Hal Jackson's International Talented Teen 2005, Ms. America's Outstanding Teen Talent Winner 2006, and Virgin Islands Carnival Queen 2007. In 2011, she was selected as one of "The 50 Most Beautiful Women in the World" by a panel of judges for Global Beauties, based on top international pageants held worldwide that year. During the Miss World 2011 pageant, she finished as part of the Top 15 semifinalists, placing in the Top 36 for Beach Beauty, second place in the talent round, and part of the Top 20 for the Beauty with Purpose segment. The pageant was won by Ivian Sarcos of Venezuela. Esonica is also a makeup artist and model coach, providing support to young women who aspire to possess poise, finesse, and beauty. She represented the US Virgin Islands at Miss Universe 2017 and did not place, but placed in the Top 20 in the National Costume competition. Esonica also appeared on Season 2 of Temptation Island, an American reality television program broadcast on USA Network, where she and her boyfriend participated in a relationship test by living with singles of the opposite sex.
